correctness.rationale: Dimension one has Aut=K* for zero multiplication or trivial Aut for nonzero square, so only F4 gives C3. Perfect dimension two is monomial; a 3-element subgroup must be diagonal because S2 has no 3-torsion. Support loops rule out nontrivial diagonal C3, so only a directed two-cycle, with diagonal parameters t^3=1 and off-diagonal parameters s^3=alpha^-1, produces the exact cubic criterion. Nonperfect rank-one multiplication-image cases reduce to bilinear similarity stabilizers, none of order three outside F4. For dimension three, cyclic successor+loop structure has only rotations and trivial diagonal Aut; char2 finite exceptions use a pure cycle with all t forced to 1. Independent from source code, complete prime-field automorphism enumeration found dim2 structures with exactly C3: F2=0,F3=0,F5=0,F7=24 (all perfect), and full GL3 matrix enumeration found precisely 3 automorphisms of the specified F2 and F3 3D examples.
